title: Venom and Lead
description:
Make a base, go mining, get guns, kill the spider gods with overpowered artillery.

- GUNS, EXPLOSIONS, BASE DEFENDING AND BUNKER RAIDING
- 3 CRAZY DIFFICULT DIMENSIONS
- MULTIPLAYER BUILT IN VIA ESSENTIAL!
- VOICE CHAT, EMOTES,
body:
Giant spiders, horrors, and more!
Gather supplies call in airdrops, raid bunkers and DONT DIE!
3 hardcore dimensions filled with nope. Bring guns... lots of them. 
Voice chat included
Multiplayer support via Essential Mod! 3-5 players recommended. 
SERIOUS WARNING: IF YOU ARE PLAYING MULTIPLAYER, HAVE THE PERSON WITH THE BEST WIFI AND COMPUTER HOST!!
